entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Neither. I just didn't get to it in time. I've had other priorities.
I understand. Can you tell me a little more about what happened? Our return window is time-sensitive, so any details are helpful.
Look, we had a family emergency. My son was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. It wasn't exactly top of mind to return a gadget.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well. Let me just double-check the policy against your delivery date. I see it was delivered 22 days ago.
Okay, I'm looking at our internal knowledge base... and yes, you're perfectly fine. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So, 22 days is well within the timeframe.
Oh. Well, that was surprisingly simple. I was expecting a fight.

Not at all! We try to make it easy. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. You can just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Good. Between my son's recovery and my wife's upcoming deployment, I didn't have the energy for a hassle. Thanks.
Of course, Mark. We completely understand. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your family all the best.
